verdict.rationale: The docs describe a live preview that gives a human control when a challenge persists, which is a mid-run takeover. They also describe getting a `live_view_url` from the `browser.ready` event so a user can step in (e.g., for 2FA) and then continue in the same session. Ordered event polling supports watching a run live. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the live-preview page itself, explicit pause/resume or hand-back of control to the agent during an active run (the 2FA flow relies on a planned stop), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
